validation_errors.message: 'This Scientific Reports article examines whether psychedelic use changes metaphysical beliefs about reality, consciousness, and free will. It finds shifts away from hard physicalism or materialism and toward non-physicalist views, especially panpsychism and dualism, using both a prospective ceremony survey and a smaller randomized psilocybin therapy comparison. The results are tied to emotional synchrony and mental-health improvement, but the authors emphasize contextual and sample-selection limits.' is too long
